name: you
text: Hello! A guide outside told me to come here to continue the admission process. I've got my enrollment form, so... what now?

name: adminBuildingGuy
text: Very good, sir. You need to submit that form in Room 104.

name: you
text: Room 104. Got it. Finally, someone who gives clear instructions. This admission process might actually be easy.

name: adminBuildingGuy
text: You'll find it down the corridor. Just follow the room numbers.
